svg.title: Real-world effects landing through the terminal
svg.desc: Four external surfaces a drone reaches into through the terminal, each rendered close to the real app: the Stripe Dashboard issuing payments, a Reddit thread receiving a typed comment, Grants.gov filling out a federal application, and VS Code writing a webhook handler. Each lights up in turn as the drone causes the effect, and the prior surfaces stay populated.
